fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on anticipated legislative reforms in Florida; criticism of public-utility service and telephone charges between Miami and Miami Beach; discussion of municipal transit policy and a bus-operation agreement affecting the City of Miami; and business coverage urging lower Florida East Coast Railway freight and passenger rates with reference to a Railroad Commission hearing. Also includes local entertainment and sports notices (including Miami Beach benefit events and racing/kennel club promotions), along with advertisements and society/around-town items.
